observation: Poetry 2.0 doesn't support the latest PyPy release ### Description PyPy installs a few packages required for operation that are normally on PyPI into its stdlib folder. title: Microsoft must provide a caching proxy for all the files this project links to
observation: Microsoft must provide a caching proxy for all the files this project links to **Describe the problem** This project links to a ton of files hosted by others, to be downloaded by everyone directly from there. This has the advantage of linking directly to the authoritative source (good), but it also has many problems: - Offloading the network/bandwidth cost onto open source projects with (usually) no funding for the infrastructure used by Microsoft, especially no funding from Microsoft itself. - Reliability issues, because instead of having one server that needs to be available, users need all N servers to be available at the same time.
